summary: This foreign private issuer's Form 6-K reports the closing of MDJM LTD's (registrant) acquisition of a 75% equity interest in Mirai Co., Ltd. through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mansions Catering and Hotel LTD. The purchase was completed on June 11, 2026 per a Share Purchase Agreement dated May 6, 2026. Amendment No.1 provides that the third installment will be satisfied by issuing 730,000 newly issued Class A ordinary shares at a deemed price of $0.575 per share. The seller also gave a tax audit indemnity. Watch for economic dilution from the share issuance and integration risk of cross-border targets.
